enhancements.name: Regrowth

enhancements.name: Seed of Rebirth
enhancements.effect: Effect: If your general would be destroyed, before removing them from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, your general is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on them have no effect. Then, Heal (1) your general. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

abilities.name: Verdurous Harmony

Declare: Pick one of the following friendly units to use this ability:

• A unit that destroyed an enemy unit this turn.

Effect: Roll once on the Eye of the Gods table for that unit. That unit gains the Eye of the Gods passive ability that corresponds to the roll (the unit keeps all Eye of the Gods abilities gained in previous turns). If the same unit gains the same ability more than once in the battle, the effects are not cumulative.

Eye of the Gods Table:
1: Snubbed by the Gods: No effect.
2: Ward of Tzeentch: This unit has Ward (6+).
3: Grace of Slaanesh: Add 1 to run rolls for this unit.
4: Blessing of Nurgle: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.
5: Fury of Khorne: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons.

battleTraits.name: LIGHTNING REACTIONS
battleTraits.effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a Fight ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, you can pick 2 units instead of 1. Resolve the second Fight ability immediately after the first.
battleTraits.timing: Passive

regimentAbilities.name: ARCANE PROWESS
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for your general.
regimentAbilities.timing: Passive

regimentAbilities.name: HEIGHTENED REFLEXES
regimentAbilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly units that use a Fight ability immediately after another friendly unit because of the ‘Lightning Reactions’ ability, until the end of the phase.
regimentAbilities.timing: Passive

enhancements.name: OVERWHELMING HEAT
enhancements.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 24" of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 7+, halve the Move characteristic of that unit until the start of your next turn and roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds that unit’s Save characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

enhancements.name: PROTECTION OF HYSH
enhancements.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 7+, the target has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

enhancements.name: WAYSTONE
enhancements.effect: Remove your general from the battlefield and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 6" from all enemy units.

enhancements.name: SPEED OF HYSH
enhancements.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of your general, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: On a 5+, double the Move characteristic of that unit until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: DARKNESS OF THE SOUL
abilities.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then roll a dice.

Effect: On a 3+, subtract D6 from the control score of the target unit this turn.

abilities.name: SWORDMASTERS
abilities.effect: Each time this unit uses a Fight ability, you must pick either the Perfect Strike or Flurry of Blows weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its Sunmetal Greatblade. In addition: Do not use the attack sequence for an attack made with Perfect Strike. Instead, roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target unit.

abilities.name: GUARDIANS
abilities.effect: While your general is wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and your general have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: LOFTED SHOTS
abilities.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s Auralan Bows but subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.

abilities.name: LOFTED SHOTS

abilities.name: MOONFIRE FLASK
abilities.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target, then roll a dice.

Effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase

battleTraits.name: The Lurking Vermintide
battleTraits.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.

Effect: The target unit is set up in reserve in the tunnels below. Units in the tunnels below that have not used the 'Gnawhole Ambush' ability by the end of the third battle round are destroyed.
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase

battleTraits.name: Gnawhole Ambush
battleTraits.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is in the tunnels below to use this ability.

Effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a corner of the battlefield and more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.timing: Your Movement Phase

regimentAbilities.name: Warpstone-Laced Bullets
regimentAbilities.effect:
Declare: Pick a ranged weapon a friendly unit is armed with.

Effect: That weapon has Crit (Mortal) this phase.
regimentAbilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase

regimentAbilities.name: Too Quick to Hit-Hit
regimentAbilities.effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly units when they use Retreat abilities.
regimentAbilities.timing: Passive

enhancements.name: Lead the Seething Horde
enhancements.effect: Instead of using the set-up instructions in the 'Call for Reinforcements' ability, the replacement unit can be set up wholly within 13" of this unit and not in combat.
enhancements.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Call for Reinforcements' ability

enhancements.name: Skryre Connections
enhancements.effect: Your general's Ratling Pistol has an Attacks characteristic of 2D6 instead of D6.

enhancements.name: Warpstone Charm
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units in combat with your general.

enhancements.name: Cloak of Stitched Victories
enhancements.effect: Your general has Ward (5+).

abilities.name: Cornered Rat
abilities.effect: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its Warpforged Halberd.

Effect: On a 3+, add the roll to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.

abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of its Warplock Musket to 3 this phase. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Shoot ability for this unit and it has not used a Move ability this turn

battleTraits.name: Always Three Clawsteps Ahead
battleTraits.effect:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is not in combat.

Effect: That unit can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

regimentAbilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an Attack ability and targeted your Stormfiends unit

enhancements.name: Skilled Manipulator
